name: hypotize
description: The first agentic Growth OS: turns your AI agent into a disciplined growth hacker, with a scored backlog, an enforced lifecycle and a queryable record of learnings.

interface.longDescription: Hypotize is the first agentic Growth OS. Your agent reads the team's experiment backlog before proposing, writes hypothesis-first ideas, scores them with ICE, PIE, RICE or a custom framework, moves experiments through an enforced lifecycle and records measured outcomes and learnings. The plugin bundles the Hypotize MCP server (21 tools, OAuth) and three skills: the experiment method, a weekly pipeline review and a backlog import from spreadsheets or Notion. Hypotize does not run A/B tests: it keeps the record before and after they run.
defaultPrompt: Review our experiment pipeline and tell me what needs a decision this week
Propose three experiments to improve activation, checking what we already tested
Import our growth backlog from this spreadsheet into Hypotize
